note: Configures an Aptina MT9V03x camera and acquires images in one process and sends them from another. Without a camera, imager_configure() fails and the application prints 'img0 manager problem' at once (Asmodee_H747, no camera attached, 2026-11-09), so its row needs --have camera.

tests.note: checks only that the camera configures; what a good image looks like is not specified yet, because no bench board has the camera
